body:
### Summary

This is only a logging issue: `uv self update` uses [UV_ASTRAL_MIRROR_URL](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/environment/#uv_astral_mirror_url) for all actions. Most notably, it passes a custom `UV_DOWNLOAD_URL` to the installer script to fetch uv sources from the mirror.

However, it happily logs a Github URL in the success:
`success: Upgraded uv from v0.12.19 to v0.12.23! https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.12.23`
The mirror url should be used when provided at this line: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/blob/822539467aa0744075b4ffde516db85ed0a547c5/crates/uv/src/commands/self_update.rs#L390

I'm setting up uv use in all python projects for an administration.
Security requires that components operate exclusively through proxy repositories, for traceability and failover (in case of outage or geopolitical threats).
uv mainly complies, but there are a few quirks: i'm creating issues for each of them. In this case, even if it's only a logging issue, users are thrown off.

My team would be happy to contribute with your approval: we are not Rust experts, but we can learn!

### Platform

Linux 6.8.0-138-generic x86_64 GNU/Linux, Windows 11 x64

### Version

0.12.19-23

### Python version

_No response_
title: uv self update does not use astral mirror value when logging
